Shown when the same save changed on two devices. Two cards, one per copy, carry the device, the time and which is newer; the person keeps this device's copy, the other one, or both when a slot is free.

## In each kit

<Tabs syncKey="ui-kit">
  <TabItem label="React">
    <KitStatus kit="react" />

    **Drop-in.** `<SaveConflict bytes={...} />` from `@polaris-key/react/kit`, inside `<PolarisKeyProvider config={polarisKey}>`. It follows the first conflict a write ended with and settles it with `resolve`; `bytes` returns this device's copy for Keep this and Keep both. With no conflict it draws nothing. A conflict that appears after a save takes focus once. Cancel keeps the conflict pending; the [Cloud Sync strip](/docs/build/ui/components/cloud-sync-status/) keeps asking, and Review opens the screen again.

    **Cards.** Every SDK stores `savedAt` (milliseconds) and `deviceLabel` (the device's display name, never a hardware value) in the metadata of each save, and the cards read them. Your own `savedAt` or `deviceLabel` key is overwritten. `describe` is optional and overrides a card's `when`, `device` or `newer`.

    **Styled part and headless.** Given an `input.saveConflict` it is the plain part and the host drives it; `viewOf("SaveConflict", input)` returns the view.

  </TabItem>
</Tabs>
